dedupe_keys.name: rextag natural gas and miscellaneous gases gis datasets pipelines facilities and service territories commercial

description: Rextag sells GIS datasets for the energy industry, and its Natural Gas Dataset states over 1.24 million miles of digitised natural gas pipelines in North America and nearly one million miles worldwide. It includes gathering, transmission and distribution pipelines with owner, operator, pipeline type, diameter, operational status, system name, state, flow direction, mileage and previous ownership; facility layers for processing plants, storage facilities, compressor stations, meter points and LNG terminals, some with capacity, throughput and production figures; and gas service territories with operator, owner and service type. A companion Miscellaneous Gases Pipelines Dataset covers ammonia, CO2 and other industrial gas pipelines. Rextag states that names, commodities, locations and status are normalised with proprietary owner and operator identifiers, and that datasets are updated continuously with monthly updates available to download for customers. Access is a paid licence, with licensing information and demos on request by phone or form, under an end user licence agreement. Coverage is North America in detail and worldwide pipelines. Caveats: proprietary data, delivery format not stated on the page read, and completeness figures are the vendor's own. Simulation uses are gas and CO2 pipeline topology with diameters and facilities for network flow and exposure models. Related records: data-mapsearch-natural-gas-gis-data is a competing commercial product.
